desc: The Bergara B-14R Bolt Action Rifle was years in the making. Our goal was simple: make the best production precision .22 possible for both beginners and seasoned competitors. The Bergara B-14R was a product that our customers and enthusiasts had been requesting for quite some time, and with our expertise, and the growing participation in NRL22 and PRS .22 competitive matches, we delivered a product that’s on target and exceeded expectations.
